description: Check whether a platform subdomain can be claimed before calling set_app_subdomain. Returns available plus a status of available, invalid, reserved, taken, current, or empty, with the exact reason. Pass app_id (an app you own) to have that app's own current subdomain reported as 'current' instead of 'taken'.

app_id.description: Optional ID of an app you own. When supplied, this app's own subdomain reports as 'current' instead of 'taken'.

name: check_subdomain_available
title: Check Subdomain Available
